context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the useLogin mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-commercejs to initiate the Commerce.js passwordless login flow. It assesses email argument passing, callback URL construction using the deployment URL helper, and proper hook invocation patterns.

checklist.name: useLogin hook usage
checklist.description: The useLogin mutation hook is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs and properly initialized

checklist.name: Email argument
checklist.description: The mutation is called with the email address collected from the form input

checklist.name: Callback URL construction
checklist.description: The login callback URL is constructed using the deployment URL helper, pointing to the /api/login endpoint. The base URL is resolved from NEXT_PUBLIC_COMMERCEJS_DEPLOYMENT_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_URL, or falls back to http://localhost:3000

checklist.name: Form submission handling
checklist.description: The form's default submission behavior is prevented and the mutation is invoked asynchronously on form submit
